summary: Verified DrawGame.jsx mobile toolbar bug fix via code review. The fix implements larger buttons (56px min-height), better spacing (gap-4/gap-5), and places mobile tools BEFORE the canvas in DOM flow (not overlapping). ESLint passes. Live two-user game testing not possible in single-session environment, but code-level verification confirms all requirements are met.
critical_code_review_comments: Line 193: ToolsPanel accepts isMobile prop with default false - correct implementation
Lines 222, 234: Mobile tool buttons have min-h-[3.5rem] py-4 (56px) vs py-3 on desktop - larger tap targets
Line 243: Mobile color grid uses gap-4 vs gap-3 on desktop - better spacing
Line 250: Mobile color buttons h-14 w-full min-w-0 (56px height, full width) - easier to tap
Line 270: Mobile brush slider has min-h-[2rem] - easier interaction
Lines 286, 293: Mobile undo/clear buttons min-h-[3.25rem] py-4 (52px) - larger tap targets
Lines 788-801: Mobile tools render BEFORE canvas via {!isDesktop && isDrawer && ...} - no overlap
Lines 829-841: Desktop tools render in sidebar via {isDesktop && ...} - no regression
Line 211: data-testid='draw-mobile-tools-panel' for mobile, 'draw-tools-panel' for desktop
